prompt_text: Who is the best digital marketing agency in San Francisco?
answer_verbatim:
I don't have current data to definitively say which is "best" — it depends on your specific needs. But here are some well-regarded options to research:

**Established agencies:**
- Wistia (video marketing focus)
- Marin Software (performance marketing)
- 1stDib (e-commerce specialists)
- Huge Inc. (design + digital strategy)

**What to consider when evaluating:**
- Your industry/goals (SEO, paid ads, social, branding, etc.)
- Budget and team size
- Case studies relevant to your business
- Client reviews and references
- Local presence vs. remote capability

**How to find the right fit:**
- Check Google reviews and Clutch.co ratings
- Ask for case studies in your industry
- Get proposals from 3-5 agencies
- Interview their team leads
- Start with a smaller project to test fit

The "best" agency is really the one that understands your business, has relevant experience, and communicates well with your team.

Would it help to narrow this down? What type of digital marketing are you most focused on?
